name: Billy Blind

attributes.attribute: was a male form of the banshee

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Billy Blind is a figure from British folklore. In northern England, people used this name for a male form of the banshee. A banshee is a fairy that announces when someone will die. Billy Blind could also help around the house in the same way as a brownie.

okr.objective: Portray Billy_Blind as a male banshee figure known in northern English folklore.
key_results: Billy_Blind was a folkloric figure from Britain.
He served as a male form of the banshee, the fairy that predicts death.
He also helped around the house in the manner of a brownie.
